meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求发布前审查,Claude 会找出自上次 npm 发布以来的所有改动,分组后派最多 10 个后台智能体逐组分析,另派 5 个做整体检查、1 个做最终汇总,最后给出能否发布、版本号建议和破坏性变更清单。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求发布前审查时触发(如说“pre-publish review”、“review before publish”等);普通发布请求不会触发,直接照常发布。

say.text: 帮我做发布前审查,看看现在能不能发 npm 包。
say.note: Claude 会先找出未发布的改动并分组分析。

say.text: 对最近这些改动做一次预发布检查,给出风险等级。
say.note: 会派多个智能体并行审查并汇总结论。

say.text: 准备发布前,先跑一遍 pre-publish review。
say.note: 会调用 16 个智能体做三层检查。

howto.what_en: Claude finds all changes since last npm release, groups them, spawns up to 10 agents for per-change analysis, 5 for holistic review, and 1 oracle for synthesis; outputs verdict, version bump, and breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Only when you explicitly request a pre-publish review (e.g. 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', etc.). Plain publish/release requests do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review to see if I can publish the npm package now.
say_en.note: Claude will detect unpublished changes and start the review.

say_en.text: Do a pre-release check on recent changes and give a risk level.
say_en.note: It will spawn multiple agents to review and summarize.

say_en.text: Before publishing, run pre-publish review first.
say_en.note: This invokes the full 16-agent release gate.
